Group Travel in Madagascar

Group Travel The Madagascar Collection 12 min read

The Madagascar Collection specialises in designing customised group travel experiences throughout Madagascar — from school expeditions and corporate retreats to research projects and special interest journeys. We create bespoke itineraries tailored to your group's objectives, interests and budget.

Our itineraries can be entirely land-based, fully sailing-focused aboard Luna Moon or a combination of both — creating experiences that go far beyond a traditional group tour.

Madagascar's extraordinary biodiversity makes it one of the world's most rewarding destinations for group study and discovery.

Why Choose Madagascar for Group Travel?

Madagascar is one of the world's most unique destinations, offering experiences that cannot be found anywhere else. Groups can enjoy:

  • Exceptional biodiversity and wildlife found nowhere else on Earth
  • National parks and conservation areas
  • Cultural immersion and community engagement
  • Adventure and outdoor activities
  • Marine conservation experiences
  • Educational and scientific opportunities
  • Leadership and personal development programs
  • Stunning beaches and remote islands
  • Sustainable and responsible tourism initiatives

School & Student Groups

Educational Travel Beyond the Classroom

Madagascar provides an exceptional environment for experiential learning, allowing students to engage directly with nature, conservation, culture, science and adventure. We work with schools, colleges, universities, youth organisations, leadership academies and gap-year programs to create meaningful travel experiences aligned with curriculum goals and learning outcomes.

Programs can be designed as land-based expeditions, sailing voyages or a combination of both. Educational experiences may include:

  • Wildlife and biodiversity studies
  • National park visits and conservation projects
  • Cultural immersion and community engagement
  • Leadership and personal development
  • Environmental education and ecology field studies
  • Marine science activities and adventure education

Luna Moon — the historic 132ft gaff-rigged topsail schooner built in Holland in 1910.

Luna Moon Youth Development Voyages

For groups seeking a truly transformative experience, Luna Moon offers one of the most powerful learning environments available. Aboard the historic 132ft gaff-rigged topsail schooner, students become active participants in the voyage — learning practical skills, taking responsibility, working as a team and developing confidence through hands-on experiences at sea.

"Students become active participants in the voyage rather than passive observers — learning seamanship, navigation and leadership through direct experience."

Activities include sail handling and seamanship, navigation and watchkeeping, leadership rotations, team-building exercises, marine conservation awareness, wildlife observation and scientific data collection. Voyages range from 10-day coastal expeditions to month-long leadership and youth development programs.

Madagascar's unique environments provide the perfect backdrop for meaningful team experiences.

Corporate Groups, Clubs & Sports Teams

Team Building Beyond the Boardroom

Whether you're planning a corporate incentive trip, leadership retreat, staff reward program, sports tour, alumni gathering or professional development experience, we create bespoke group itineraries designed to strengthen relationships and inspire teams.

Life aboard a traditional sailing vessel naturally develops leadership, communication, trust, collaboration, adaptability and resilience. Corporate sailing experiences can be incorporated into broader Madagascar itineraries or operated as stand-alone events. Ideal for:

  • Leadership teams and executive retreats
  • Incentive groups and staff reward programs
  • Sports clubs and alumni organisations
  • Professional associations and special interest groups

Madagascar's extraordinary biodiversity makes it a magnet for researchers, conservation organisations and documentary teams.

Research, Conservation & Academic Groups

Supporting Scientific Discovery in Madagascar

As one of the world's most important biodiversity hotspots, Madagascar attracts researchers, universities, conservation organisations, NGOs, documentary teams and citizen science initiatives from around the globe. The Madagascar Collection assists with the planning and logistics of both land-based and marine research expeditions throughout the country.

Research activities may include marine biology and oceanography, wildlife monitoring, biodiversity surveys, conservation projects, climate studies, coastal ecosystem research, community development projects and documentary production.

Luna Moon also serves as an exceptional mobile research platform, capable of accessing remote coastal regions, islands and marine environments that are difficult to reach by land.

One of the unique advantages of The Madagascar Collection — land and sea experiences combined seamlessly in a single itinerary.

The Best of Both Worlds

"One of the unique advantages of working with The Madagascar Collection is the ability to combine land and sea experiences into a single seamless itinerary."

Imagine a student group studying lemurs in Madagascar's rainforests before joining Luna Moon for a marine conservation voyage. Or a corporate team enjoying a luxury retreat and wildlife safari before embarking on a leadership-focused sailing expedition. Or a research team conducting fieldwork in national parks before accessing remote coastal ecosystems aboard Luna Moon.

Let's Design Your Group Adventure

Every Group is Different

Whether you're planning a school expedition, university field trip, corporate retreat, sports tour, conservation project or research expedition, our team will work closely with you to create a tailor-made Madagascar experience.
